newTutorials.title: Here’s How to Cut Your Seedance 2.5 Costs in Half
newTutorials.titleZh: Seedance 2.5：先做低清草稿还是直接出高清？
newTutorials.learnZh: 用同类镜头对比低清草稿→高清和直接生成高清，包括真人参考、延展布景和人群；成本是作者样本，不保证每个项目都能省一半。
newTutorials.learnEn: Compare draft-to-final with direct high-res generation for live-action references, set extensions and crowds. Cost savings are not universal.

newTutorials.title: How We Rendered a 3D-Modeled City in Unreal Engine on Higgsfield GPU
newTutorials.titleZh: 用 Claude、Blender 和 Unreal 渲染一座城
newTutorials.learnZh: 先用 Blender 灰模剪完 40 秒，按统一坐标和材质名组装 11 个模块，再到 Unreal 重做材质和灯光。先测帧再分配 GPU。近七天补入；数字来自公开镜像快照。
newTutorials.learnEn: Lock 40 seconds in Blender grey previews, align 11 modules, rebuild materials and lighting in Unreal, and test frames before splitting the GPU render. Seven-day backfill; engagement is from a public mirror.
